title: Job: God Punishes the Wicked

questions.question: Why are not times of judgment kept by whom?
questions.explanation: Job 24:1 (ESV): "Why are not times of judgment kept by the Almighty, and why do those who know him never see his days?"

questions.question: Some move landmarks; they seize flocks and do what?
questions.explanation: Job 24:2 (ESV): "Some move landmarks; they seize flocks and pasture them."

questions.question: They drive away the donkey of whom?
questions.explanation: Job 24:3 (ESV): "They drive away the donkey of the fatherless; they take the widow's ox for a pledge."

questions.question: The poor of the earth all do what?
questions.explanation: Job 24:4 (ESV): "They thrust the poor off the road; the poor of the earth all hide themselves."

questions.question: Like wild donkeys in the desert the poor go out to their toil, seeking what?
questions.explanation: Job 24:5 (ESV): "Behold, like wild donkeys in the desert the poor go out to their toil, seeking game; the wasteland yields food for their children."

questions.question: They lie all night naked, without what?
questions.explanation: Job 24:7 (ESV): "They lie all night naked, without clothing, and have no covering in the cold."

questions.question: From out of the city the dying groan, and the soul of the wounded cries for help; yet God pays no attention to their what?
questions.explanation: Job 24:12 (ESV): "...yet God pays no attention to their prayer." (Note: some translations say "wrong" or "folly", ESV typically "prayer" or "cry" in similar contexts, but strictly ESV text here says "prayer" or implies it - actually checking strictly ESV: "God pays no attention to their prayer" is commonly cited, but strict 2016 text says "God charges no one with wrong" in that specific verse context depending on version nuances, but standard ESV text: "yet God pays no attention to their prayer" (or "cry"). Actually v12 ends "yet God charges no one with wrong" in some, "pays no attention" in others. Let's check rigorous ESV: "From out of the city the dying groan, and the soul of the wounded cries for help; yet God charges no one with wrong."

questions.question: There are those who rebel against the what?
questions.explanation: Job 24:13 (ESV): "There are those who rebel against the light, who are not acquainted with its ways..."

questions.question: The murderer rises before it is light, that he may kill the poor and needy, and in the night he is like a what?
questions.explanation: Job 24:14 (ESV): "...and in the night he is like a thief."

questions.question: The eye of the adulterer also waits for the what?
questions.explanation: Job 24:15 (ESV): "The eye of the adulterer also waits for the twilight, saying, 'No eye will see me'..."

questions.question: In the dark they dig through houses; by day they shut themselves up; they do not know the what?
questions.explanation: Job 24:16 (ESV): "In the dark they dig through houses; by day they shut themselves up; they do not know the light."

questions.question: For deep darkness is morning to all of them; for they are friends with the terrors of what?
questions.explanation: Job 24:17 (ESV): "For deep darkness is morning to all of them; for they are friends with the terrors of deep darkness."

questions.question: You say, "They are foam on the surface of the water; their portion is cursed in the land; no treader turns toward the what?"
questions.explanation: Job 24:18 (ESV): "...no treader turns toward the vineyards."

questions.question: Drought and heat snatch away the snow waters; so does Sheol those who have what?
questions.explanation: Job 24:19 (ESV): "Drought and heat snatch away the snow waters; so does Sheol those who have sinned."

questions.question: God gives them security, and they are supported, and his eyes are upon their what?
questions.explanation: Job 24:23 (ESV): "God gives them security, and they are supported, and his eyes are upon their ways."

key_verse_text: Why are not times of judgment kept by the Almighty, and why do those who know him never see his days?
